name: The Drunken Master
author: Cole
description: A brewer who mixes drinks mid-combat and drinks them. Play Ingredients to fill a Brew, seal it into a Concoction potion, and get Intoxicated for Strength at the cost of control. 80+ cards, 9 relics, 3 potions. Requires BaseLib and the public-beta branch (v0.111.0+).
